family: OAuth authorization, identity governance, verification, and cloud identity assurance

selection.reason: These ten skills share bounded OAuth policy/config/scope/event and identity lifecycle/verification inputs. Static predicates are proposed only where deterministic; authorization servers, Okta/IdP, device-code, token/session telemetry, and runtime authorities remain blocked external engines. Procedure and judgment remain advisory/manual. The batch is exactly ten, disjoint from CP08 batches 01-08, and excludes the protected sourceUnavailable identity.
